definitions.explanation: Being distinctive to or characteristic of something; not shared with others.

examples.japanese: ⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧{固有|こゆう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{文化|ぶんか}→文化：01504_bunka⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{学|まな}ぶ→学ぶ：01987_manabu⟧。
examples.english: To learn about culture unique to Japan.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{地域|ちいき}→地域：01461_chiiki⟧{固有|こゆう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{動物|どうぶつ}→動物：01480_doubutsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: There are animals endemic to this region.

examples.japanese: {固有|こゆう}⟦{名詞|めいし}→名詞：10420_meishi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{大文字|おおもじ}→大文字：17142_oomoji⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{始|はじ}まる→始まる：00841_hajimaru⟧。
examples.english: Proper nouns begin with a capital letter.

notes:
FORMS:
- {固有|こゆう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ + noun: unique to ~
- {固有|こゆう}な + noun: rare; the ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ form is standard

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {固有|こゆう}⟦{名詞|めいし}→名詞：10420_meishi⟧: proper noun (grammar)
- {固有|こゆう}{種|しゅ}: endemic species
- {固有|こゆう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{文化|ぶんか}→文化：01504_bunka⟧: unique culture
- {固有|こゆう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧: inherent problem
- {固有|こゆう}{値|ち}: eigenvalue (mathematics)

COMMON PATTERNS:
X{固有|こゆう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ Y: Y unique/inherent to X
- ⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧{固有|こゆう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{文化|ぶんか}→文化：01504_bunka⟧: culture unique to Japan
- ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{地域|ちいき}→地域：01461_chiiki⟧{固有|こゆう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{動物|どうぶつ}→動物：01480_doubutsu⟧: animals endemic to this region

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{独特|どくとく}→独特：01656_dokutoku⟧: distinctive, unusual — stresses that something stands out (⟦{独特|どくとく}→独特：01656_dokutoku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{味|あじ}→味：00826_aji⟧)
- ⟦{特有|とくゆう}→特有：13471_tokuyuu⟧: characteristic of — typical of a group or condition, often of something noticed (⟦{若者|わかもの}→若者：03037_wakamono⟧⟦{特有|とくゆう}→特有：13471_tokuyuu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{言葉|ことば}→言葉：02880_kotoba⟧); {固有|こゆう} stresses that something belongs to X alone, by nature
- ⟦ユニーク→ユニーク：11393_yuniiku⟧: unique (loanword)
